verdict.rationale: Reclaim documents Scheduling Links for sharing availability and letting others book time across one or many calendars. Each link can carry its own priority level and can overbook lower-priority events. However, the evidence never shows per-link configuration of the elements this story asks for. Missing for 10: evidence of multiple distinct event types, per-type durations, per-type locations, custom booking questions, confirmation/approval rules, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
